mlagentbench.description: Run and modify ML experiments under constraints to meet a specified research or engineering goal.
mlagentbench.input: Research brief, files, tools and evaluation metric
mlagentbench.output: Task-specified artifact such as test predictions
mlagentbench.assessment: Task-specific objectives scored against benchmark success criteria

discoveryworld.description: Investigate a simulated world by conducting experiments, then explain the mechanisms discovered.
discoveryworld.input: Scientific scenario in an interactive simulated world
discoveryworld.output: Experimental actions and discovered explanatory knowledge
discoveryworld.assessment: Task completion, procedural progress and explanatory knowledge accuracy
discoveryworld.first_author_affil: Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence; University of Arizona

discoverybench.description: Analyze supplied datasets and propose a hypothesis that specifies the context, variables and their relationship.
discoverybench.output: Natural-language hypothesis supported by the analysis
discoverybench.assessment: Model-assisted hypothesis match on context, variables and relation

lab-bench.description: Answer multiple-choice questions about the interpretation of scientific literature, figures and research data.
lab-bench.input: Biology research question with answer options
lab-bench.assessment: Accuracy, precision on attempted questions and coverage

dsbench.description: Answer questions over realistic spreadsheets or build predictions for modeling competitions.
dsbench.input: Business-analysis spreadsheets or competition modeling datasets
dsbench.assessment: Answer correctness or competition-specific predictive performance
dsbench.first_author_affil: University of Texas at Dallas and Tencent AI Lab, Seattle

core-bench.description: Use a paper’s code repository to reproduce outputs and answer questions about the resulting artifacts.
core-bench.input: Reproducibility questions and a computational research repository
core-bench.assessment: Answers checked against reference results for each task

scienceagentbench.description: Generate a runnable analysis program that produces the requested scientific result from supplied data.
scienceagentbench.input: Scientific task, dataset and optional expert guidance
scienceagentbench.output: Python program and its executed results
scienceagentbench.assessment: Task-specific success; code similarity and cost also reported
scienceagentbench.first_author_affil: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, OSU

mle-bench.description: Train and submit models for Kaggle competitions, then compare their scores with human submissions.
mle-bench.input: Competition brief, dataset and submission specification
mle-bench.assessment: Competition metric and medal thresholds from human standings

re-bench.description: Compare agents with human specialists on seven open-ended research engineering tasks under time budgets.
re-bench.input: Open-ended ML engineering goal and timed environment
re-bench.output: Working solution in the task environment
re-bench.assessment: Normalized task-specific scores compared with time-budgeted human attempts
re-bench.date_note: First arXiv submission (v1, UTC). Open-ended research engineering tasks; this is not a test of repeated self-improvement.

paperbench.description: Reproduce ML papers from scratch; graders inspect code, execution and experimental results against a rubric.
paperbench.input: ML paper, clarifications and a replication environment
paperbench.output: Code, execution instructions and resulting research artifacts
paperbench.assessment: Model grader scores weighted, author-developed rubric items

terminal-bench-science.description: Complete a researcher-defined workflow in a terminal. The deliverable is a scientific result, not just code: tasks include image reconstruction, sensor calibration and model fitting.
terminal-bench-science.input: A research task, its input files and a configured terminal
terminal-bench-science.output: A task-specific artifact such as a reconstructed image or a fitted model
terminal-bench-science.assessment: Resolution rate: share of tasks whose required checks all pass
terminal-bench-science.date_note: Public announcement of version 0.1, a Stanford-led collaboration. A distinct scientific workflow benchmark, not a Terminal-Bench version.

researcharena-literature.description: Find, select and organize relevant research literature.
researcharena-literature.input: A research topic and paper corpus.
researcharena-literature.output: Selected papers and an organized overview.
researcharena-literature.assessment: Separate measures for literature discovery, selection and organization; unrelated to the later research-agent control evaluation.
